blocks.text: BAGUIO CITY – Police arrested three wanted persons, including a murder suspect who had been in hiding for more than a year, in separate manhunt operations in this city on Thursday, Nov. 12. In a report Friday, the Police Regional Office-Cordillera (PRO-CAR) said the 33-year-old murder suspect was arrested in Barangay Loakan Proper through a joint operation involving personnel from the Baguio City Police Office (BCPO), PRO-CAR Regional Intelligence Division and the Regional Intelligence Unit 14.
